payload.reason: The M2.4 read-only analysis is sufficient to authorize Slice 1. The dependency on M1.1 is satisfied, the three required seminar models and migrations already exist in the target, and AttainmentService already provides the documented Seminar grading and attainment infrastructure, so no duplicate persistence or calculation layer is justified. The six-endpoint inventory provides a bounded backend scope, and the proposed controller-plus-routes slice cleanly separates backend parity from the later dedicated verification suite. The implementation must preserve the established CampusLynk response-negotiation pattern and statutory 75-mark Seminar calculation rules, while avoiding any UI or print work because those concerns belong to later M2.5 scope. Route collision analysis is clear and no database change is required. Slice 1 is therefore approved for implementation.

task_dispatch.objective: Implement the R21 Seminar backend controller and register its six authenticated web endpoints, achieving legacy functional parity while reusing the existing CampusLynk models and AttainmentService.
instructions: Implement the new R21VirtualClassroomSeminarController using the inspected legacy controller as read-only behavioral reference.
Implement all six approved endpoints: show, uploadSyllabus, saveEvaluation, updateSeminarSchedule, printReport, and getAttainmentSummary.
Reuse the existing SeminarEvaluation, StudentSeminarRegistration, SeminarAcceptance, CourseFile, and AcademicMark models. Do not create duplicate models or migrations.
Reuse AttainmentService for Seminar grading and attainment calculations. Do not create a duplicate grading or attainment service.
Preserve the documented Clause 11.2.6 75-mark split: 67.5M seminar evaluation plus 7.5M attendance, including the six rubric/attendance components and their validation bounds.
Preserve the documented SBTE 9-point grade thresholds and pass/fail behavior.
Preserve multi-assessor evaluation averaging and the AcademicMark category='Seminar' upsert behavior.
Preserve syllabus upload validation/storage behavior and StudentSeminarRegistration schedule/topic/guide updates.
Preserve the printReport data contract and its three report modes, but do not implement or modernize Blade print templates in this slice.
Preserve getJson()/wantsJson response negotiation consistently with the established M2.1/M2.3 controller pattern. Ensure JSON negotiation occurs before normal view rendering where applicable.
Register exactly the six approved /r21/classroom/seminar/{subjectId} routes in routes/web.php using the existing route grouping/middleware conventions.
Inspect the current target files immediately before editing to account for any repository drift, but do not expand scope based on unrelated findings.
Run php -l on the new controller and modified routes file, route:list verification for the six endpoints, and the existing full test suite.
Return a TASK_REPORT only. Do not create the dedicated M2.4 feature test yet and do not commit.
constraints: Whitelist is limited to carmel-linx-laravel/app/Http/Controllers/R21VirtualClassroomSeminarController.php and carmel-linx-laravel/routes/web.php.
Do not modify migrations, database schema, models, services, Blade views, tests, User.php, STATE.json, FEATURE_MATRIX.md, or unrelated files.
Do not create duplicate Seminar models, grading services, attainment services, UI components, shells, or report infrastructure.
Do not perform destructive database operations or execute migrations.
Do not modify M2.3 or previously completed units.
Do not implement M2.5 presentation/print frontend work.
Do not commit or mutate persistent migration state.
task_dispatch.expected_report: A TASK_REPORT containing exact files changed, all six endpoint implementations, route registrations, validation and statutory calculation parity, model/service reuse, response-negotiation behavior, route-list evidence, syntax results, full-suite results, whitelist compliance, safety checks, and any discovered issues or ambiguities.
stop_conditions: Stop if any required implementation needs a file outside the two-file whitelist.
Stop if a required grading/calculation behavior conflicts with the existing AttainmentService contract; report the conflict rather than creating a parallel service.
Stop if database/schema changes appear necessary.
Stop after controller and route implementation plus verification.
Do not create tests in this slice.
Return only the TASK_REPORT for architect review.
